name: production-code-audit
description: Audit a codebase the way years of production use would: enumerate, understand, hunt with single-question lenses, reproduce, verify adversarially, then fix with regression tests.
suggestedPrompts: Audit this repo for production readiness and show me what will break
Go deep on everything that touches money, auth, or the database, with proof
Find the edge-case bugs in this service before we launch
